title: Do You Have to Port Your Number to Use an AI Receptionist? No. Forward It
meta_description: Read on 28 September 2026: forwarding puts an AI receptionist on your existing number in one star code, a US port takes 5 to 15 days on Twilio and 1 to 7 business days on Telnyx, and the forwarding line can never be the transfer target.
secondary_keywords: ai receptionist keep my phone number
port business phone number to twilio
ai answering service existing phone number

image.takeaway: Forward the number first; a US port takes 5 to 15 days on Twilio and Twilio charges nothing to port it in.
image.alt: Do you have to port your number to use an AI receptionist? No, forward it first and port to a carrier you control later
